summary: Implementation is minimal, correctly scoped to AC-1/AC-2/AC-5/AC-6 (link-only evidence), and is backed by 16 passing tests that map cleanly to the acceptance criteria table. The only real issues are a small rel-attribute inconsistency between the two links, an unused `evidence.type` discriminant, and documentation drift (jsdom vs the actually-configured happy-dom) plus a repo-wide eslint.config.js side effect that, while justified and disclosed, was made outside this task's declared file scope.

findings.issue: The new evidence link uses `rel="noreferrer"` (line 83) while the pre-existing GitHub link uses `rel="noreferrer noopener"` (line 73) for the same `target="_blank"` pattern.
findings.better_approach: Use `rel="noreferrer noopener"` on the evidence link too, matching the existing GitHub link.
findings.reason: Consistency with the established pattern in the same file; `noreferrer` alone is sufficient in modern browsers but mixing conventions in one component reads as an oversight and could regress if someone copies the weaker pattern elsewhere. Test (`Projects.test.tsx:53`) only asserts rel contains 'noreferrer', so it does not catch this drift.

findings.issue: `evidence.type: "link"` is a single-value string literal discriminant that is never branched on anywhere in Projects.tsx — it's stored but unused data (dead field) at this point in time.
findings.better_approach: Either drop `type` until a second variant (e.g. `"image"`) is actually implemented, or keep it but note explicitly in a code comment that it's a forward-compat placeholder for AC-3/AC-4.
findings.reason: CAVEMAN principle: don't add fields/abstractions the current code doesn't use. plan.md itself flags this as intentional ('type düzeyinde opsiyonel genişletilebilir bırakılır'), so it's a conscious tradeoff, but it is literally unused code today and should be called out rather than silently accepted.

findings.issue: test_diff.md and verify_report.md both describe the test environment as 'jsdom', but vitest.config.ts actually configures `environment: "happy-dom"`.
findings.better_approach: Correct the artifact docs to say happy-dom, or switch vitest.config.ts to jsdom if that was the intended choice.
findings.reason: Documentation/traceability accuracy — future maintainers reading test_diff.md will look for a jsdom dependency that isn't actually used, and the IntersectionObserver mock rationale ('jsdom'da bu API'yi bulamadığı için') is describing the wrong runtime.

findings.issue: eslint.config.js was modified (removal of eslint-plugin-prettier/recommended) to work around a toolchain breakage caused by adding vitest as a devDependency for this task. This file is not listed in atdd.md's affected modules and the change has repo-wide effect: it unmasked ~15,800 pre-existing lint errors across unrelated files (AiPipeline.tsx, Identity.tsx, TechStack.tsx, etc.).
findings.better_approach: Keep the eslint.config.js fix, since it's a legitimate and well-documented unblock, but land it as a separate, clearly-labeled commit/PR from the evidence-link feature, and file the 15,800 pre-existing lint errors as a tracked follow-up Saga item before merge, not just a note in verify_report.md.
findings.reason: atdd.md explicitly scopes this task to the project-card/data files; a global toolchain config change bundled into the same diff makes the feature PR harder to review/revert independently, and the newly-surfaced lint debt is a project-wide finding that deserves its own visibility rather than being buried in this task's verify report.

strengths: Panel component keeps the existing GitHub link (href/target/rel/className) completely untouched — additive-only change satisfies AC-2/AC-6 rollback expectation in atdd.md line 84.
evidence field is optional (`evidence?: {...}`) so all 4 existing PROJECTS entries compile without modification — build/tsc/lint all pass per verify_report.md gates 2, 4, 5.
Test suite (Projects.test.tsx) directly names each `describe` block after the AC it verifies (AC-1/AC-2/AC-5/AC-6), making the ATDD traceability easy to audit; 16/16 tests pass.
security-scan (verify_report.md gate 10) correctly found no issue since evidence.url/label are static, developer-controlled TypeScript literals, not user input — no injection surface introduced.

AC-3/AC-4 deferral (image/GIF evidence, lazy-load, prefers-reduced-motion) is consistently and explicitly documented across atdd.md, plan.md, code_diff.md, test_diff.md and verify_report.md as a conscious scope decision rather than a silently dropped requirement.
risks: PROJECTS array still has no real evidence data for any of the 4 projects (placeholder-only) — the feature is merged as pure mechanism with zero user-visible effect until content is added in a follow-up task, so the stated benchmark ('60-80% of featured cards should have clickable evidence') is not yet met.

The eslint.config.js change surfaces ~15,800 pre-existing errors project-wide; if not tracked as a follow-up item, this technical debt risks being forgotten since it was discovered as a side effect rather than the primary goal of a task.

No automated check exists (and none is planned) for evidence URLs going stale/404 (atdd.md explicitly accepts this as out of scope) — acceptable per spec, but worth reconfirming with the user before real evidence links are entered later.
